f75C6kv02eQZBiKXPVbzhg.zh: 據俄羅斯當地媒體報導,該國西伯利亞伊爾庫茨克州(Irkutsk)疑出現第2例死亡病例,惟尚未經證實;WHO表示正要求該國提供更多病例相關資訊。
f75C6kv02eQZBiKXPVbzhg.en: According to local Russian media, a second death may have occurred in Irkutsk Oblast in Siberia, though this has not been confirmed. WHO says it is requesting further information on the cases from the country.

WBP8DFMOSZJ2S6j0JdwMDA.zh: 俄羅斯西伯利亞伊爾庫茨克州(Irkutsk)於10/2報告1例疑肺鼠疫(Pneumonic plague)死亡病例,病患為伊爾庫茨克防疫研究所28 歲之女性實驗室技術人員,疑於9/25不慎打破裝有鼠疫桿菌的試管,2日後病情惡化,出現嚴重肺炎後死亡。惟另有一說表示病患係從布里亞特共和國出差返回後發病。當局已匡列約200名密切接觸者進行隔離,醫院亦進行封鎖,並強制周邊工廠人員佩戴口罩,據報導部分接觸者已出現疑症狀。當局宣稱該案為不明原因肺炎且周遭情況穩定,然相關資訊仍待釐清。另WHO資料顯示2019-2025年全球累計有10國報告疑或確定病例。
WBP8DFMOSZJ2S6j0JdwMDA.en: On 2 October, Irkutsk Oblast in Siberian Russia reported one suspected death from pneumonic plague. The patient was a 28-year-old female laboratory technician at the Irkutsk anti-plague research institute, who is suspected to have accidentally broken a test tube containing plague bacteria on 25 September. Her condition deteriorated two days later, and she died after developing severe pneumonia. Another account states that the patient fell ill after returning from a business trip to the Republic of Buryatia. Authorities have placed approximately 200 close contacts in quarantine, the hospital has been locked down, and workers at surrounding factories have been required to wear masks; some contacts have reportedly developed suspicious symptoms. Authorities state that the case is pneumonia of unknown cause and that the surrounding situation is stable, but relevant information remains to be clarified. WHO data show that between 2019 and 2025, a total of 10 countries worldwide reported suspected or confirmed cases.

UIJn3UECDC2XmN741Zexag.zh: 俄羅斯外貝加爾邊疆區(Zabaykalsky Krai)疫情自6月底以來持續處於高點,今年第31週(7/27-8/2)報告139例病例,病患以6歲以下幼童為多,具校園或機構群聚傳播情形,當局已發布指引,呼籲加強手部衛生,並落實生病學童停課並在家休養。 韓國疫情於高點略降,第31週(7/26-8/1)的定醫門診就診千分比為35,以0至6歲幼童為多,檢出型別以克沙奇A6型為多,並有報告急性無力肢體麻痺(AFP)病例。當前疫情雖高,惟仍低於2019及2024年的歷史高峰,當局已發布警示,呼籲生病幼童應停課並在家休養。
UIJn3UECDC2XmN741Zexag.en: In Zabaykalsky Krai, Russia, enterovirus activity has remained at a high level since late June. In week 31 (27 July–2 August) of this year, 139 cases were reported, mainly children under 6, with clusters in schools and institutions. Authorities have issued guidance calling for enhanced hand hygiene and requiring sick children to stay home from school and rest at home. South Korea's epidemic has slightly declined from its peak. In week 31 (26 July–1 August), the sentinel outpatient visit rate was 35 per 1,000, mainly among children aged 0–6; the predominant type detected was coxsackievirus A6, and acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) cases have been reported. Although the current epidemic is high, it remains below the historical peaks of 2019 and 2024. Authorities have issued an alert urging that sick children stay home from school and rest at home.

_1us1I8gl2vFEScXV_045Q.zh: 俄羅斯鄂木斯克州自 2026 年 4 月初起,通報 3 例人類狂犬病確定死亡病例。個案均為被家中貓狗咬傷後,未及時尋求或拒絕暴露後預防接種(PEP)而發病致死。該國每年記錄 2-6 例死亡案例,鄂木斯克州於今年 5 月底已達到/超過全國年度死亡數下限。 義大利威托大區 1 例自摩洛哥非法輸入犬隻於 5/27 確定染病,並遭安樂死,目前無人類感染病例。此為該國近 15 年來首度通報動物個案,專家強調須落實跨部門「健康一體」(One Health)的應對機制,嚴遵守跨國移動的動物檢疫與疫苗規範,才能有效防範人畜共通傳染病的再次爆發。
_1us1I8gl2vFEScXV_045Q.en: Omsk Oblast in the Russian Federation has reported three confirmed human rabies deaths since early April 2026. All patients were bitten by household cats or dogs and did not seek, or refused, timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and died as a result. The country records two to six rabies deaths each year, and Omsk Oblast had reached or exceeded the national annual lower limit for deaths by late May this year. In Italy's Veneto Region, one dog illegally imported from Morocco was confirmed infected with rabies on 27 May and was euthanised. No human infections have been reported. This is the first animal case reported in the country in nearly 15 years. Experts stress the need for a cross-sectoral One Health response, with strict compliance with animal quarantine and vaccination rules for cross-border movement, to prevent a recurrence of zoonotic outbreaks.

015946KZMLOyxMS5ty9tuA.zh: 俄羅斯弗拉迪米爾州(Vladimir)4/7-13累計報告677例急性腸胃炎病例,其中36例經實驗室檢測為諾羅病毒感染,約半數病患為兒童。經當局調查疑感染源可能為飲用水遭受汙染。
015946KZMLOyxMS5ty9tuA.en: In Vladimir Oblast, Russia, a total of 677 acute gastroenteritis cases were reported for 7–13 April. Of these, 36 were laboratory-confirmed as norovirus infections, and about half of the patients were children. Authorities' investigation indicates that the suspected source of infection may be contaminated drinking water.

AA3PEnj6eulTyI266gP9gw.zh: 俄國中部克麥羅沃州(Kemerovo)2025年12月截至今年2月初累計報告10例死亡病例,病患皆為某醫院產房新生兒,先前感染源不明,經採檢醫院牆壁環境檢體呈黏質沙雷氏桿菌(Serratia marcescens)陽性,且產婦入院時檢測為陰性,經當局評估院內感染的可能原因包含感管疏失、環境污染、或假期期間之醫護人力緊縮所致
AA3PEnj6eulTyI266gP9gw.en: In Kemerovo Oblast in central Russia, 10 deaths were reported cumulatively from December 2025 to early February this year. All patients were newborns in the maternity ward of one hospital. The source of infection was initially unknown. Samples from hospital wall surfaces tested positive for Serratia marcescens, while the mothers tested negative on admission. Authorities assess that possible causes of the hospital-acquired infection include lapses in infection control, environmental contamination, or reduced staffing during the holiday period.

sZBvI6oOQg0GzpRCisxBfA.zh: 俄羅斯南部克麥羅沃州新庫茲涅茨克市婦產科醫院報告9例新生兒死亡,死亡發生於2025/12/1-2026/1/11期間,並以早產及低出生體重嬰兒為主。該院宣布爆發急性呼吸道感染疫情,並於1/12暫時關閉,感染源迄仍不明,當局已啟動調查,並公布該院因違規行為須停業90天。
sZBvI6oOQg0GzpRCisxBfA.en: A maternity hospital in Novokuznetsk, Kemerovo Oblast, southern Russia, reported 9 neonatal deaths between 1 December 2025 and 11 January 2026, mainly among preterm and low-birth-weight infants. The hospital announced an outbreak of acute respiratory infection and temporarily closed on 12 January. The source of infection remains unknown. Authorities have launched an investigation and announced that the hospital has been suspended from operating for 90 days due to violations.

yUYOD4zKik5GzOh0BSbAQg.zh: 俄羅斯2025年1至10月累計報告逾3,300例病例,為去年同期1.5倍,病患以都市居民為主(占86%),呈現與過去以鄉村為主的不同流行趨勢;當局研判,人類與齧齒類動物的接觸模式正在改變,可能與秋季鼠類遷入都市建築及周邊環境有關,進而在人口稠密地區形成新的暴露途徑。
yUYOD4zKik5GzOh0BSbAQg.en: Russia reported more than 3,300 cases from January to October 2025, 1.5 times the same period last year. Most patients (86%) were urban residents, a pattern that differs from the past, when cases were mainly rural. Authorities assess that human contact patterns with rodents are changing, possibly because rodents move into urban buildings and surrounding areas in autumn, creating new exposure routes in densely populated areas.

HZC5zDVS6ihdvWcd74Ca6A.zh: 俄羅斯報告多個地區出現不明原因疾病,病患症狀包含疲倦、全身痠痛、咳嗽/血及高燒等,部分個案之流感及新冠檢測結果均為陰性,且有抗藥性出現,醫護推測可能與肺炎黴漿菌相關,惟該國當局仍未證實且未公布病例數。
HZC5zDVS6ihdvWcd74Ca6A.en: Russia has reported unexplained illness in several regions. Symptoms include fatigue, body aches, coughing (including coughing up blood) and high fever. Some cases tested negative for influenza and COVID-19, and drug resistance has been observed. Clinicians suspect a link to Mycoplasma pneumoniae, but Russian authorities have not confirmed this and have not published case numbers.
